title: Arms tournament (held-out) — a fresh 20-task genre-balanced sample from works the routing rule never saw, all eight arms, judge 1.1 (Wave Q — Model Discovery, PR-74)

routingRule.method: per family: ON iff cells ≥ 6 and mean(score(COMPOSERS_ASSISTANT_2+CTX) − score(COMPOSERS_ASSISTANT_2)) > 0; OFF iff cells ≥ 6 and mean ≤ 0; otherwise the pooled default (sign of the mean over all cells). Failures are cells scored 0, as the tournament scores them.

controlAccuracy.note: Every arm's output is measured against the bins the +PREFIX request carried in the same (task, seed) cell. Only the arms marked `asked` received them; the rest are the no-instruction baseline. Loudness has no realised value (CA2 emits no velocities).
